title: Pickup Inspection Rate Card — Trade-In Agreements
content:
The pickup inspection under **Trade-In Agreements** measures the vehicle against what the customer stated at offer. Its findings are priced, grade by grade, at the figures below, together with the regrade threshold and the re-acceptance threshold.

| Figure | Inoperable | Rough | Fair | Good | Very Good | Excellent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mileage tolerance (miles the inspected odometer may exceed the stated mileage) | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 |
| Mileage overage deduction per mile | $0.03 | $0.06 | $0.08 | $0.10 | $0.12 | $0.14 |
| Missing key or fob, per key declared and not handed over | $0.00 | $150.00 | $200.00 | $250.00 | $300.00 | $350.00 |
| Undisclosed dashboard warning light lit at inspection | $0.00 | $250.00 | $300.00 | $400.00 | $450.00 | $500.00 |
| Undisclosed smoke or pet odor | $0.00 | $200.00 | $300.00 | $400.00 | $500.00 | $600.00 |
| Undisclosed aftermarket modification (lift, tint below legal limit, exhaust, wheels) | $0.00 | $100.00 | $200.00 | $300.00 | $400.00 | $500.00 |
| Minimum tread expected on every tire (32nds of an inch) | 0 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 |
| Deduction per tire below the minimum tread | $0.00 | $75.00 | $100.00 | $125.00 | $150.00 | $175.00 |
| Undisclosed damage regrade threshold (repair estimate above which the offer is regraded one grade down) | $0.00 | $500.00 | $750.00 | $1000.00 | $1000.00 | $1000.00 |
| Maximum regrades per accepted offer | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Re-acceptance threshold (total inspection reduction above which the customer re-accepts) | $100.00 | $250.00 | $250.00 | $500.00 | $500.00 | $750.00 |

## How the figures read

- **Regrade threshold of $0.00.** At the Inoperable grade the threshold is $0.00, which means undisclosed damage is always deducted at its repair estimate there and never regrades the offer.
- **Threshold comparisons.** A repair estimate regrades the offer only when it is above the grade's threshold; an estimate equal to the threshold is deducted. The re-acceptance threshold is likewise passed only when the inspection reduction is above it.
- **Per-unit figures.** The key deduction is charged per declared key not handed over, and the tire deduction per tire below the minimum tread.

## Rate lookups (hypothetical findings)

| Finding | Grade | Figure from this card |
|---|---|---|
| One of two declared fobs not handed over | Very Good Condition Offer | $300.00 |
| Two tires at 3/32 in | Good Condition Offer (minimum 4) | $125.00 per tire, $250.00 in all |
| Two tires at 3/32 in | Fair Condition Offer (minimum 3) | Not below the minimum, no tire deduction |
| Undisclosed damage estimated at $750.00 | Fair Condition Offer | Equal to the threshold, deducted rather than regraded |
| Undisclosed damage estimated at $760.00 | Fair Condition Offer | Above the threshold, regraded one grade down |
